# FreshBite Pets

> Mobile, natural, non-invasive preventive oral care for dogs and cats in the Greater Dallas-Fort Worth area, Texas. Not grooming, not a medical procedure, and never a replacement for veterinary care. No anesthesia or sedation. Care focuses on visible tooth surfaces above the gumline.

- Business: FreshBite Pets Natural Oral Care LLC
- Founder: Daiana de Paula
- Service area: Greater DFW, TX (mobile, at the client's home)
- Visit length: 60 to 90 minutes per pet; reminder every 6 months
- Contact: freshbitepets@gmail.com, +1 (833) 944-4486 (call or text)
- Social: instagram.com/freshbitepets, facebook.com/freshbitepets, tiktok.com/@fresh.bite.pets

- [Contact](https://www.freshbitepets.com/contact): online booking, call, text, email and social media
